output.summary: KEP-4958 proposes combining the CSI sidecars (external-attacher, external-provisioner, external-resizer, external-snapshotter, livenessprobe, node-driver-registrar, volume-health-monitor, volume-data-source-validator) into a single monorepo that produces one binary and container image. The KEP's status is implementable at alpha stage.
output.rationale: Maintaining many separate sidecar repositories and releases costs SIG Storage maintainers effort and forces CSI driver authors and administrators to track many components. The design merges the sidecars so common libraries propagate immediately, releases are reduced, and a shared informer lowers memory use and API server calls. Alpha is the current stage per the status fact; the sources record reviewer approval for alpha but also note that the lease-migration concern raised in December 2025 was still to be addressed.

alternatives.option: Switch sidecar versioning to Kubernetes release versions
alternatives.why_not: The KEP states: "After investigation, we found that there isn't clear advantage to switch to k8s versioning, so we are going to stick with the semantic versioning."

alternatives.option: Use Go Workspaces with multiple go.mod files in the monorepo
alternatives.why_not: The KEP concludes: "we will adopt a single go.mod and go.work file at the root directory. Nested, imported repositories will not have their own go.mod files." Multiple go.mod files were rejected in favor of a single root module.
It is a non-goal: "Because it doesn't depend on release-tools or csi-lib-utils."

evidence.quote: From the single repository, produce a single artifact(binary and container image) similar to how kube-controller-manager operates.
Reduce the memory usage/API Server calls done by the CSI Sidecars through the usage of a shared informer.
After investigation, we found that there isn't clear advantage to switch to k8s versioning, so we are going to stick with the semantic versioning.
This KEP does not handle leader election locks that were held by different components before upgrade and hence would allow parallel running of two resizers, provisioners etc.
/lgtm /approve for alpha. I think the KEP is overly verbose, but that does not make it unacceptable.
